name: Phuvah
overview: Phuvah, also referred to as Pua or Puah, is identified in Scripture as one of the sons of Issachar, a tribe of Israel. The genealogical records in Genesis 46:13, Numbers 26:23, and 1 Chronicles 7:1 consistently list Phuvah among Issachar's descendants, emphasizing his role as a patriarch whose family formed one of the clans within the tribe. These passages highlight the importance of lineage and tribal identity in God's covenant people, with Phuvah's descendants contributing to the fulfillment of God's promises to Israel.
